content.comment_body: Hello, I have been testing the deployment of a web page made with [product_name] in AWS, following what was shown in some videos. After registering [product_name] in AWS IoT and linking my page to the relevant components, the display process does not complete properly—a message appears saying it could not be displayed. After investigating, I discovered that the service created with [product_name] is being deployed to an Elastic Beanstalk instance in AWS. When I access my AWS environment, I see that the [product_name] environment was deployed, but the application state is marked as deprecated. I'm unsure if this is due to AWS no longer supporting the required platform version, which may have caused the deployment error. The app is running on Tomcat with Java 8 on 64-bit Amazon Linux. My question: Is there a solution I can use to successfully deploy this application?

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced deployment problems when attempting to host a web page created with [product_name] on AWS. Although the deployment proceeds, the application's state is marked as deprecated, resulting in improper display. The main concern seems to be incompatibility between the requirements of [product_name] and current AWS platform support, possibly due to a deprecated environment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to deploy and operate their web page on AWS smoothly, seeking clear solutions if platform version issues arise. They prefer the deployment process to be simple and fully compatible with AWS services.
